اكتفيتما (form VIII)
# اِكْتَفَيْتُمَا (iktafaytumā) /ik.ta.faj.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
# اُكْتُفِيتُمَا (uktufītumā) /uk.tu.fiː.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
